description: 开源自建 AI 新闻雷达，从 RSS、Hacker News、Reddit、Telegram、X、GitHub 等信源抓新闻，用大模型打分去重，生成中英双语每日简报。
descriptionEn: Open-source self-hosted AI news radar that pulls from RSS, Hacker News, Reddit, Telegram, X and GitHub, scores and deduplicates with a large model, and generates bilingual daily briefings.
name: Horizon
warningText: 避坑提醒：必须自备大模型 API Key，评分和摘要的调用费自己出；X 信源要 Apify Token；没有 PyPI 包和 GitHub Release，要自己配 config.json 和 .env，不是开箱即用。
warningTextEn: You must bring your own large-model API key and pay for scoring and summarisation calls. The X source needs an Apify token, and there is no PyPI package or release, so you must configure config.json and .env yourself.

name: Agent Skills
subcategory: Claude Agent Skills 官方合集
description: Anthropic 官方开源的 Agent Skills 合集：创意、开发、企业办公与文档处理等场景的现成技能，每个技能都是独立文件夹，Claude Code 里一条命令就能装成插件市场，照着写自己的技能也有样板，README 声明多数技能 Apache 2.0 开源。
descriptionEn: Anthropic's official collection of Agent Skills for Claude: ready-made skills for creative work, development, enterprise workflows and document handling, each a self-contained folder; installable as a Claude Code plugin marketplace with one command, and a reference for writing your own skills.
warningText: 避坑提醒：仓库根目录没有 LICENSE 文件，README 只说多数技能按 Apache 2.0 开源，商用前自己再核对一次；技能只是指令与脚本合集，要装 Claude Code 或在 Claude 里用才跑得起来，部分技能还要另外配 API 或装依赖，不是开箱即用的独立应用；Claude.ai 上用技能要付费套餐。
warningTextEn: The repo root has no LICENSE file — the README says most skills are Apache 2.0, so double-check before commercial use. Skills are instruction and script bundles that need Claude Code or Claude to run; some need extra API keys or dependencies, and using skills on Claude.ai requires a paid plan.

name: Daily Stock Analysis
description: 免费开源的 LLM 股票智能分析系统：覆盖 A 股、港股、美股、日股、韩股与台股，每天自动拉行情与实时新闻出决策仪表盘，推到企业微信、飞书、Telegram 或邮箱，GitHub Actions 定时跑零成本，MIT 协议。
descriptionEn: Free open-source LLM stock analysis system for A-shares, Hong Kong, US, Japanese, Korean and Taiwanese markets: it pulls market data and live news daily, builds a decision dashboard and pushes it to WeChat Work, Feishu, Telegram or email, running on GitHub Actions at zero cost.
warningText: 避坑提醒：分析结论是大模型生成的参考意见，不是投资建议，盈亏自负；要自己配大模型 API Key，免费额度用完要自己掏钱；行情与新闻源来自第三方接口，延迟或断线时报告会缺数据；项目首页挂了模型中转服务的赞助广告，别当成官方推荐。
warningTextEn: Its conclusions are LLM-generated reference opinions, not investment advice — you bear your own gains and losses. You must bring your own LLM API key, and pay once free quotas run out. Market and news data come from third-party APIs, so reports can go thin when a source lags or drops. The project homepage carries a sponsored ad for a model API reseller; treat it as an ad, not an official recommendation.

name: Rakazo
description: 免费开源的 Grok Bot 平替：给每个 AI 队友配专属记忆、定时任务、浏览器与电脑，自带沙箱跑在自己的机器或服务器上，模型随便换、密钥自己管，支持群聊分工与语音通话，Apache-2.0 协议。
descriptionEn: Free open-source Grok Bot alternative: persistent AI teammates with their own memory, routines, browser and computer, running in sandboxes on your own machine or server with any model and your own keys, plus group chats, delegation and voice calls.
warningText: 避坑提醒：工具本身免费开源，但跑模型要自己掏 API 费用，密钥自己管好；自建要准备服务器或 Docker 环境，还要给每个 Bot 配沙箱电脑，资源开销不小；App Store 与 Google Play 上的客户端免费下载，功能以自建服务端为准。
warningTextEn: The tool itself is free and open source, but model usage is billed to your own API keys — keep them safe. Self-hosting needs a server or Docker and a sandbox computer per bot, so budget the resources. The App Store and Google Play clients are free downloads, but features depend on your own server.

description: 纯 Rust 写的开源软件重建引擎：先实测研究任意网站、App 或游戏是怎么做的，再让编程 Agent 按你指定的技术栈重做一个自己的版本，做完还对照原作逐项打磨，带 320 个工具、命令行与 MCP，MIT 或 Apache-2.0 双协议。
descriptionEn: An open-source software-rebuilding engine written in pure Rust: it studies how any website, app or game actually works, then has a coding agent rebuild your own version in the stack you choose, refining it against the original, with 320 tools, a CLI and MCP support, under MIT or Apache-2.0.
name: Craft Anything
warningText: 避坑提醒：项目明确标注还是早期 alpha 版，功能与接口都可能大改；重建要接自己已登录的编码 Agent，生成图片与 3D 模型还要自备 fal.ai 的 Key，那部分要另外花钱；照着别人的产品重做时别原样抄人家的界面与素材，小心版权问题。
warningTextEn: The project is explicitly early alpha, so features and interfaces may change a lot. Rebuilding needs your own logged-in coding agent, and generating images or 3D models needs your own fal.ai key, which costs extra. When recreating someone else's product, do not copy its interface and assets verbatim — mind copyright.

description: YC 总裁 Garry Tan 自用的开源 AI Agent 记忆层：Markdown 打底、Postgres 向量库存记忆，自动把对话与资料织成带出处的知识图谱，多个 Agent 共用同一份记忆，换 Agent 也不丢上下文，MIT 协议，自托管完全免费。
descriptionEn: The open-source persistent memory layer YC president Garry Tan uses himself: Markdown files backed by a Postgres vector store, automatically woven into a cited knowledge graph that multiple agents share, so context survives switching agents, under the MIT license and free to self-host.
name: gbrain
warningText: 避坑提醒：免费的是自托管版，官网 gbrain.io 的托管版要付费订阅（个人版 49 美元/月起），别直接在官网开付费套餐；语义检索等进阶功能要自备大模型 API，模型费用自己掏；npm 上有个同名的无关包，装的时候认准 github.com/garrytan/gbrain 这个仓库。
warningTextEn: Only the self-hosted edition is free — the hosted service on gbrain.io is a paid subscription starting at $49/month, so do not sign up there expecting it free. Advanced features like semantic search need your own model API, and you pay that bill. There is an unrelated package with the same name on npm, so install from the github.com/garrytan/gbrain repo only.

description: 免费开源的 Home Assistant MCP 服务器：让 Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor 等 AI 助手用自然语言配置与操控你的智能家居，87 个工具覆盖自动化、仪表盘、备份与摄像头，MIT 协议，今日仍在 GitHub Trending 日榜上。
descriptionEn: Free open-source MCP server for Home Assistant: it lets Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other AI assistants configure and control your smart home in plain language, with 87 tools covering automations, dashboards, backups and cameras, under the MIT license.
name: ha-mcp
warningText: 避坑提醒：使用前提是自己已经有一台跑起来的 Home Assistant，它本身不带智能家居硬件；让 AI 助手直接操作家里的灯、锁与摄像头之前，先在 Home Assistant 里把权限收紧，别把全屋控制权裸着交给模型；更新到 v9 大版本时先看一遍迁移说明。
warningTextEn: You need your own running Home Assistant first — this ships no smart-home hardware itself. Before letting an AI assistant operate your lights, locks and cameras, tighten permissions in Home Assistant; do not hand whole-home control to a model unchecked. Read the migration notes before upgrading to the v9 major release.
